explication: Articraft turns a prompt (optionally with a reference image) into an articulated 3D record, then exposes records through a browser-based viewer. The principal path is CLI → agent run and tool loop → model code using the SDK → compiled/persisted record; users can also fork/edit records and inspect library metadata, runs, trajectories, and geometry. The README documents generation, editing, library maintenance, and viewing; SOURCE INDEX references support several internal links. Unsampled implementations are represented only at the exact paths available in the tree, with uncertain wiring omitted.
